defs.def: the part of the face that sticks out above the mouth, used for breathing and smelling things 鼻；鼻子

ex.s: They use their noses to assess their environment and look out for any signs of danger.
ex.t: 它们用鼻子来评估周围环境，并留意任何危险的迹象。

ex.s: Why did soda go up the author’s nose one time?
ex.t: 为什么有一次苏打水进了作者的鼻子里？

ex.s: The researchers found that the dogs were able to pick the angry or happy face by touching a picture of it with their noses more often than one would expect by random chance.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，狗能够通过用鼻子触碰图片来选择愤怒或快乐的面孔，其正确率高于随机概率。

ex.s: That is until I put on my curly rainbow wig, big red nose, and add my name badge "Doctor Larry Laugh-Out-Loud".
ex.t: 直到我戴上卷曲的彩虹色假发、大红鼻子，并加上我的名牌“Larry Laugh-Out-Loud医生”，情况才有所改变。

ex.s: Well, when I take off my wig and my red nose, I'm still wearing a big smile, as I remember all the fun and laughter of the day.
ex.t: 嗯，当我摘下假发和红鼻子时，我仍然带着灿烂的笑容，因为我记得这一天所有的欢乐和笑声。

ex.s: I can see the children flattening their noses against the window.
ex.t: 我能看到孩子们把鼻子贴在窗玻璃上。

ex.s: She put her nose on it.

defs.def: having the type of nose mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: The hungry bear followed his nose to our camp，which was surrounded by a high wire fence.
ex.t: 那只饥饿的熊循着气味来到我们的营地，营地四周围着高高的铁丝网。

defs.def: the front part of a plane, spacecraft, etc. （飞机、太空船等的）头部，头锥
a special ability for finding or recognizing sth 发现（或辨别）事物的能力；嗅觉
a sense of smell 嗅觉
if sth is under sb's nose, it is very close to them but they cannot see it 就在某人面前（却看不见）

ex.s: under my noseD. beyond my wildest dreams
ex.t: 他们甚至能分辨出母亲的声音和陌生女性的声音。

ex.s: In winter, scientists brave heavy snow and freezing temperatures to supply food to the Golden Snub-nosed Monkey.
ex.t: 冬天，科学家们冒着大雪和严寒为川金丝猴供给食物。

defs.def: if sth happens under sb's nose, they do not notice it even though it is not being done secretly 当着某人的面，就在某人眼皮底下（却没有被察觉）
to move forward slowly and carefully 小心翼翼地向前移动
to search for sth or push sth with its nose 动物

ex.s: Shennongjia supports more than 600 vertebrate species, including the Golden Snub-nosed Monkey and the Clouded Leopard.
ex.t: 神农架栖息着600多种脊椎动物，包括金丝猴和云豹。
